notes: אֵין־לָהֶם לָחַשׁ is recast as 'will not be charmed': the existential takes 'will not', the noun takes 'be charmed', and the preposition with its suffix is left unrepresented under rule 40.

Competing reading worth recording: the auxiliary 'will' could be read as belonging to the recast passive 'will be charmed' rather than to the existential. The accepted reading is kept because rule 50 assigns the existential's copula and negation to the אַיִן unit, and the unit still heads on 'not'.
The suffix on הִנְנִי takes the subject pronoun 'I' under rule 18, and the object marker אֶתְכֶם is unrepresented with the pronoun written bare (rule 16).
